patch.value: Compact default list receipts and avoid repeated recovery argument echoes

GitHub source https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1251. GitHub reports 31 output lines for a complete three-item default list and repeated long argument values in missing-id recovery. Historical explicit compact-mode trimming is already shipped; this report concerns default rendering and conditional receipt retention.

A complete default three-item list uses approximately six lines; incomplete and truncated reads preserve actionable receipts; structured full output remains available; missing-id recovery does not repeat long argument values.
Compact default list receipts and avoid repeated recovery argument echoes
Lower agent recovery cost and preserve safe customizable SDK composition
